title: Mini Pumpkin
description: A tiny autumn amigurumi pumpkin, perfect for seasonal decor or a keychain charm.
expectationText: A festive little project that introduces oval shaping through strategic increases and decreases. Makes a great seasonal accent.

steps.title: Make the pumpkin body
steps.instruction: Start with a magic ring in orange. The body is worked in continuous rounds.

steps.title: Round 1
steps.instruction: Work 6 single crochet into the magic ring.

steps.title: Round 2
steps.instruction: Increase in each stitch around for 12 stitches.

steps.title: Round 3
steps.instruction: Work 1 single crochet and 1 increase alternately around for 18 stitches.

steps.title: Rounds 4 to 8
steps.instruction: Single crochet around without changing to build the pumpkin height.

steps.title: Rounds 9 to 10
steps.instruction: Work 1 single crochet and 1 decrease alternately around, then decrease every stitch to close. Stuff firmly before closing completely.

steps.title: Make the stem
steps.instruction: Switch to green yarn. Chain 5, single crochet back along the chain. Sew the stem to the top of the pumpkin.
